summary: Backend first-finish test for Tenuta Barbon WMS. Auth, listing, dashboard, filtering, deletes, operator admin-rules, movements and PDF export all work. Bottling business logic is CORRECT server-side (HL math, raw-material decrement for tenuta_barbon, no-decrement + not_deducted flag for cliente, new-lot creation, finished-item credit). However every POST that returns a freshly created document (groups, raw-items, finished-items, bottling) responds with HTTP 500 because the handler returns the mongo doc without stripping the ObjectId `_id` field, causing FastAPI's jsonable_encoder to fail with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. The record is actually persisted (verified via subsequent GET), so clients get a 500 while the data IS written - this will break frontend flows that rely on the response (e.g. getting the new id, closing modals, chaining bottling PDF download).
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns token + user (admin role)
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns all 7 expected keys
GET /api/groups?kind=raw returns 5 seeded groups (Capsule, Bottiglie vuote, Etichette, Cartoni, Tappi)
GET /api/groups?kind=finished returns 4 seeded groups
GET /api/raw-items returns 16 seeded items and filters by group_id correctly
GET /api/finished-items returns 6 seeded lots
POST /api/raw-items/{id}/adjust works and updates quantity (needs quantity_delta + reason)
POST /api/finished-items/{id}/adjust works
Bottling business logic verified via GET /api/bottling: HL correct for 200x0.75=1.5, 100x0.75=0.75, 50x0.5=0.25
Bottling tenuta_barbon decrements listed raw materials by exact qty
Bottling cliente does NOT decrement raw materials; materials recorded with not_deducted=true
Bottling increments finished_item quantity by bottle_count (820->1020->1120 observed)
Bottling with new_lot_name + finished_group_id creates new finished lot and credits bottles
GET /api/bottling/{id}/pdf returns 200, content-type application/pdf, body starts with %PDF-1.4
GET /api/movements returns records and supports kind + operator_id filters
POST /api/auth/operators (admin) creates operator; non-admin receives 403
DELETE /api/auth/operators/{id} works; admin cannot delete self (400)
DELETE /api/raw-items/{id} and /api/finished-items/{id} work and log movements
Unauthenticated request to /api/dashboard/summary returns 401

failed.evidence: Backend log: TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable (fastapi.encoders.jsonable_encoder). Root cause: create_group returns `doc` which contains `_id` ObjectId set by pymongo's insert_one side effect; `id` is added but `_id` is never popped.

failed.evidence: Same ObjectId serialization bug in create_raw at server.py ~L289-297. Response not strippable with .json().

failed.issue: Returns 500 although finished lot is inserted
failed.evidence: Same ObjectId serialization bug in create_finished.

failed.issue: Returns 500 although bottling is persisted and all inventory updates occur correctly
failed.evidence: All three bottling attempts (tenuta_barbon, cliente, new_lot) returned 500 but GET /api/bottling shows them with correct hl values and materials[*].not_deducted flags. Same serialization bug - handler returns the mongo doc containing ObjectId _id.

failed.issue: Frontend will not receive the new resource id/body, breaking modal close / chained PDF download / optimistic UI patterns.
failed.evidence: 4 of the main POST endpoints affected.

action_items: In server.py, fix all POST create endpoints to strip the ObjectId before returning. Either call `serialize(doc)` (which pops `_id` and adds `id`) or build the response dict explicitly without `_id`. Affected: create_group (L257), create_raw (L289), create_finished (L341), create_bottling (L419). The simplest fix is to replace `return doc` with `return serialize(doc)` (and remove the manual `doc['id'] = ...` lines).
After fix, re-run backend tests; the business logic itself is sound so only response serialization needs attention.
